text: APPROVE. Moving the per-direction scan into `IsKeySetLiveInDirection` is behaviour-preserving, because the old `break` on dedent only ended the inner loop and the new `return false` ends only that direction before the outer loop tries the next step. The cognitive complexity of both methods is well under 15 (about 3 for `IsAlsoSetLive`, about 10 for the helper), and the helper is a private static method with matching parameter types and a valid cref, so there is no sign of a build break. I reviewed the diff only and did not build it.
